material_weaknesses.issue: Alternative target knowable at submission may eliminate prediction task
material_weaknesses.impact: A different target already knowable at submission is not necessarily a useful forecast and may be deterministically revealed by available inputs. Distinguish target definition from target value availability and reassess utility/leakage before adopting this alternative.

material_weaknesses.issue: Single snapshot cannot establish feature-change history
material_weaknesses.impact: One observed snapshot generally cannot demonstrate whether a value changed after submission unless it contains reliable dated history. Require version/transition evidence, immutable field guarantees or a defensible prospective redesign; do not infer those from the proposed snapshot inspection.

material_weaknesses.issue: Fixed decision horizon needs observation evidence beyond age restriction
material_weaknesses.impact: A W-old cohort can be reasonable, but eventual approval requires finalization evidence; approved-within-W requires dated decisions and complete coverage, including appeals/revisions. Status-by-snapshot alone cannot establish either.

material_weaknesses.issue: Empty-split handling and rebuild-budget interpretation omitted
material_weaknesses.impact: The majority calculation needs explicit empty-train/eval handling. No construction has run, so a prelaunch repair is not automatically a spent structural rebuild; dropping on another review defect is an unverified policy inference, not execution evidence.

review.rationale: B supplies the concrete fail-closed full-artifact qualification/acceptance pipeline, preserves failed reports and actually repairs majority accuracy. A omits those compound requirements and replaces the smoke test with a file-existence check that can miss retained early computation. B still needs substantial corrections: retain the supervised target, inspect fitted reference features, and substantiate the proposed observation mechanism. The preference does not imply implementation readiness.
